utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Tess — I can help at the community center on Sunday with sorting the donated tools and the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s perfect, Sam—thanks! I’ll let folks know you’ve got the tools and sign-in table covered.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Glad to help, Tess—just let me know if anything else needs covering on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still asking around, Jules — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the time and meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I’ll be ready to help once you know the time and meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, Jules — I’m out running errands now, so I’ll keep asking and let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I was just checking if anything moved. I can head to the north entrance by the community center parking lot when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—if you take the Maple Park side, the north entrance is still by the community center parking lot. That should get you right to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks — I’ll use the Maple Park side and head to the north entrance.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the list organized. If you can, help gather the addresses and I’ll sort out what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start gathering addresses and send them over as I get them. I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive too!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Quinn — that’s a huge help. Send the addresses when you have them, and I’ll keep the Sunday community center details updated for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — I’ll send the updated list for Sunday at the community center, and I really appreciate you reaching out to neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Rosa — I’ll start reaching out and help spread the word for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Sam — I’ll get the updated list out right away so everyone knows to meet Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll add you to the invite list, and we can start with whatever needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. Sunday at the community center works for me—just let me know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—Sunday at the community center it is! I’ll send you the details and let you know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll check who’s available and what tools they can lend, then I’ll send you the update.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, it’s still happening today—I’m checking on availability and tools now, and I’ll send you the update as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Uli — I really appreciate it, and I’ll make sure everyone knows where to find you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’ll be there at the sign-in table and keep the tools in order.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Uli — I’ll spread the word so folks can find you at the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina. I’ll be there and help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll just bring my hands and a screwdriver if I find one. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina. I’ll see you there and help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Pia — I’ll check the tools list on the table and confirm the drop-off time. I’m a little foggy, but I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — that helps. If you can confirm the drop-off time, I’ll sort the boxes so we stay on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll head over now and check the time on the drop-off list. Thanks, Pia — I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for the time and place. Just pass along the latest needs when you know them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll share the latest needs as soon as I hear them, and I’ll send along the time and place too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate it. I’ll wait on your update and spread the word once I’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 works for me—I’ll bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, thanks Faye — I’ll have the tools ready for Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you Saturday at 10 — I’ll be there and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ve got tape for sure, and I’ll see if I can find a hammer too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Bo — tape and a hammer would help a lot. Just bring them by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll drop them off when I’m free.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — a supply list would really help. I’m going to check which tools and spare parts we’re still short on.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can help with the supply list—just tell me what’s still missing and what time to bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’ll take a quick look and let you know the missing tools and parts. Bring it by around 3:00 if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still confirming the exact time and spot, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — just let me know the time and place when you confirm, and I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll confirm the time and place and pass it along as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll set up the table and greet folks when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Leo — could you also help me keep an eye on the tools table later? I’ll bring the sign-up sheet and a few extra pens.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll keep an eye on the tools table too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’m still catching up, so I’ll send folks your way and keep an ear out for any extra tools or parts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Nell — just send folks over, and if you spot any extra tools or parts, I’ll put them to use.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll send people your way and flag any extra tools or parts I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring the tools I promised and meet you wherever the group sets up, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — could you let me know the time once it’s set, and I’ll make sure we meet at the setup spot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Hana — I’ll let you know as soon as the time’s set. I’ll meet you at the setup spot with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll be there at 3:00 with the broken item and any charger or parts I have.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, Eli—3:00 works well. Just bring the broken item and any parts or charger you have, and we’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye. I’ll be there at 3:00 with the broken item and any parts I have.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the time and meeting spot before I confirm anything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — it’s at 10 a.m. by the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — 10 a.m. at the community center entrance works for me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — the community center by Maple Park works for now. I’ll point you there and keep the tools ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks. I’ll head to the community center by Maple Park and check in there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll meet you at the community center by Maple Park and point you in as soon as you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Dane — I’ve got the table organized and I’m waiting for you. Just bring the extras when you can, and we’ll sort everything together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m on my way with the extra supplies and should be there soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Dane — I’ve got everything set out and I’m ready to sort it as soon as you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, we’re still good for today, right? If so, I can tell you what needs fixing before you head over.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on for today. Send me the list and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks—just to confirm, you’re still coming later today? I’ll send the fix list now.
